Variants.Content: Entry The Frozen Coast is located on the cold coast north of the Great Wall. Sea ice, frozen soil, storms and short summers constitute the world here. The settlements of free people were scattered and fragile. The residents relied on fishing, hunting sea animals, gathering, small amounts of grazing and seasonal migration; walrus tusks, Here people’s understanding of “lords” or “frontiers” is less important than their understanding of weather, ice and game migrations. The frozen coast is not a no-man's land, but the land cannot support large-scale towns.
